scope: General specializer preprocessing memory lifetime reduction; no B token or compiler flag change
before: Retain all expanded chunk bodies in a list, allocate a joined copy, keep the list live while clang compiles
after: Write the same head/body token text incrementally and close the aggregate before clang; retain only the current expanded piece
checks: Actual clang preprocessing and BPF compilation, four chunks with line/file macro expansion; aggregate exactly equals independent previous materialized-join algorithm
error_path: Actual preprocessing failure in later chunk propagates; compiler is never invoked on partial aggregate, no object produced
path_note: Separate before/after directories change source-location text; each aggregate is byte-exact against the old join for its own actual preprocessor outputs
limitation: Removes parent retention proportional to full expanded B; does not establish total compiler RSS, CPU-time improvement, or resolution of prior SIGKILL
